fail.name: paddies-7
fail.problems: At 8x nearest-neighbour beside both wuxia references, the roof remains mask-like: dark notches in the pale upper band resemble eyes, and the repeated light rectangles across the lower grey band resemble teeth. The broad squared U-shaped rim does not establish a clear sloping tiled roof with distinct upturned eave tips. The pale front wall and right-hand doorway help, but the building does not meet the required unambiguous wuxia-house read. The buffalo, yard, full containment, crisp pixels and tile-edge joins are acceptable.
